# Five-wall rotor regression frame

An empty C4 rotor photographed on a bright workbench, with off-center framing.
This 960 x 540 JPEG was taken from the existing raw preview stream; no motor or
camera settings were changed. It catches the old whole-bright-image circle fit,
which incorrectly used the workbench as part of the disc.

Saved arc geometry scaled into this frame: center (502.5, 257), outer radius
280 pixels. Assertions measure five-wall consistency, not independently
surveyed absolute angular accuracy. Do not use this fixture as a machine
calibration or commissioning substitute.
